data.title: 丰川祥子 · 观众席上的乐团起点
data.description: 祥子穿整齐校服坐在学校礼堂第一排侧边的观众椅上，膝上放着折好的节目单。她双手轻压节目单，抬起金黄色眼睛注视画面外的舞台；一束柔和侧光照亮微微扬起的嘴角，前后相邻的空座椅明确表现她是听众。
data.action: 双手压着膝上的节目单，抬眼专注聆听舞台演奏。
data.promptProse: Sakiko Togawa listens from the school auditorium's first-row side seat, both hands resting on the folded program in her lap. Her navy blazer and ribbon-tied blue hair remain neat as golden-yellow eyes lift toward the off-frame stage with a small inspired smile. The medium portrait includes empty padded chairs directly ahead and behind. A gentle side spotlight illuminates her cheek and program edge, casting soft chair-back shadows that establish her audience position.
